name: pocketmc
title: PocketMC Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
description: Model Context Protocol tools for orchestrating local Minecraft servers, managing Adoptium Java runtimes, querying Playit.gg tunnels, and triggering automated backups.

transports.description: Hosted cloud proxy streamable HTTP transport
Local desktop instance streamable HTTP transport
Standard input/output transport for local desktop AI assistants

tools.name: pocketmc_list_instances
tools.description: List all configured local Minecraft server instances along with their status (running, stopped, starting), server software engine (PaperMC, Fabric, BDS, etc.), port number, player count, and resource allocation.

statusFilter.description: Optional filter to restrict results to running or stopped server instances.

tools.name: pocketmc_start_instance
tools.description: Start a specific local Minecraft server instance by its unique instance ID or name.

instanceId.description: The unique identifier or directory name of the Minecraft server instance to start.

tools.name: pocketmc_stop_instance
tools.description: Gracefully stop a running Minecraft server instance using authenticated RCON save-all and stop sequence to prevent world corruption.

instanceId.description: The unique identifier of the Minecraft server instance to stop.

force.description: Set to true only if graceful RCON shutdown fails after timeout.

tools.name: pocketmc_get_instance_status
tools.description: Get detailed real-time telemetry for a server instance including CPU percentage, RAM consumption, uptime, TPS, and list of online players.

instanceId.description: The unique identifier of the Minecraft server instance.

tools.name: pocketmc_create_backup
tools.description: Trigger an immediate, integrity-checked backup of a server instance with optional OAuth cloud replication to Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive.

instanceId.description: The unique identifier of the Minecraft server instance to back up.

cloudSync.description: Whether to sync the resulting archive to configured cloud storage.

tools.name: pocketmc_get_logs
tools.description: Fetch sanitized, color-coded console logs for a server instance with IP addresses, emails, and passwords automatically redacted.

instanceId.description: The unique identifier of the server instance.

lines.description: Number of log lines to retrieve (default: 100, max: 1000).

tools.name: pocketmc_manage_playit_tunnel
tools.description: Retrieve or reconfigure the Playit.gg network tunnel status and public domain address for a server instance.

instanceId.description: The unique identifier of the server instance.
